properties.description: Allowlist for Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/deployments sku.name. The default allows only Standard, which keeps inference in the resource's geography; GlobalStandard, DataZoneStandard and Global batch types may process data outside Canada (C5, D-006). Allowlist rather than denylist, so new deployment types are denied until reviewed. https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/foundry-models/concepts/deployment-types
